QuestInfo.name: [Grand Athenaeum] Sefirot's Gardener
QuestInfo.0:
Sefirot, a desolate sanctuary without a Transcendent.

A gardener dedicated to the sanctuary's care.
Mortal souls in search of divinity.

Unquenchable flames will rise between them.
